prompt_subtasks.item: Initial request: Compile and run all COBOL programs from the acherm/agentic-cobol-game15tictactoe repository (specifically commits 4ae3129) using an existing COBOL interpreter
Final intent: Build a COBOL-to-C compiler that produces native-speed binaries while reusing the existing parser front-end
Self-hosted COBOL tools: Both interpreter and compiler written in COBOL itself, compiled with GnuCOBOL
Three-phase architecture: Load/Preprocess → Parse → Execute (interpreter) or Compile to C (compiler)
Symbol table: Stores 200 variables with type, value, array info
Instruction table: Stores 2000 compiled instructions with opcodes and arguments
Paragraph table: Tracks function definitions and line ranges
Array storage: Uses packed character strings with calculated offsets for 1D, 2D, and nested subscripts
REDEFINES mechanism: Overlays storage between variables
Expression evaluator: Shunting-yard algorithm for COMPUTE statements
Condition evaluator: Recursive descent with compound AND/OR support
Continuation line joining: Detects multi-line statements by keywords and operators
Code generation: Maps COBOL statements to C equivalents, generates helper functions
